name: Kuroki Mikage
source:
Head maid and the most capable one. She keeps the protagonist on schedule and in line whenever he crosses it. Has announced that she is finally retiring. This leaves the protagonist with the task to find a new head maid but no one seems to want the job, forcing him to explore each maid to find right match.

[spoiler]Mikage casually mentions to the protagonist during a blowjob that she is a married woman and her husband has the biggest penis she's seen, with the protagonist's being the second biggest. She doesn't mention if her husband knows about all her job details, but seems to imply she is happily married.[/spoiler]
